entries.reason: the 9.3.6 rung is the first held rung that exports this class and its metaclass and no earlier held rung does, so the port defines it; the two classes share one object because the subclass is a subclass of the superclass and release-split measures per object file. The first held rung that exports it, measured over every held cache - 4.3, 6.1.3, 7.0, 7.1, 7.1.1, 7.1.2 and 8.0 armv7, 8.1.3, 8.2 and 8.4.1 armv7s, 9.3.6 armv7, 10.0.1, 11.0 and 12.0 arm64, 16.0 arm64e - with _nsfilesize planted as a control, which answers 4.3 on this set, with a nonsense symbol in none of the fifteen
entries.effect: the class resolves, an instance is constructible, and every member the header declares is answered: asked of an INSTANCE, because a class cluster's root does not declare what its private subclass implements. The differential in tests/backports/host/avf-descriptors links one probe twice and compares presence, superclass, instance size and the selectors an instance answers, host against port
